'''Esfandia''' was a free-floating proto-world in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. At one time, it had orbited a [[Star/Legends|star]], but it eventually broke away. Even without a sun, the planet had enough radioactivity in its core to support a liquid [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] composed mainly of [[Methane/Legends|methane]] and [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]].

Esfandia and [[Generis/Legends|Generis]] were the only two planets containing [[HoloNet relay/Legends|HoloNet relays]] to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Esfandia Long-Range Communications Base]] was a mobile relay base stationed on Esfandia and crewed by twelve people. Its purpose was to maintain the relays scattered around the planet. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] stationed two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] and the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Corellian Way]]'' around the planet to protect the station. The [[Battle of Esfandia]] occurred in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], when [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces under the command of [[B'shith Vorrik]] attempted to knock out communications between the Unknown Regions and the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
